final_identity_formula.primary_atomic_edge_phi: phi_id = sha256(json_canonical({identity_version: 'alpha_memory.phi_edge.v1', ticker, alpha_id, taxonomy_version, taxonomy_sha256, source, edge_type, target}))
final_identity_formula.secondary_aggregate_fingerprint: aggregate_fingerprint_id = sha256(json_canonical({identity_version: 'alpha_memory.aggregate_fingerprint.v1', ticker, alpha_id, taxonomy_version, taxonomy_sha256, chain_edges: sorted[(source, edge_type, target), ...]})) -- arithmetic BYTE-IDENTICAL to Step 1's original whole-set computation; only the name/classification and version string changed.
final_identity_formula.fields_never_dropped: alpha_id and edge_type both remain part of the atomic identity, per the ablation audit's own finding that dropping either would silently merge structures with real, non-noise semantic content (intentional within-run multi-Alpha attribution; at least one genuine causal-vs-conflicting disagreement).

hierarchy.level_1_primary: Atomic edge phi (one per qualifying edge per Alpha) -- the durable, primary cross-run matching unit as of this step.
hierarchy.level_2_secondary: Whole-Alpha aggregate fingerprint (Step 1's original computation, unchanged arithmetic) -- retained ONLY as a coarse diagnostic/QA signal, never the primary identity. Zero aggregate-fingerprint overlap must never be read as zero atomic-phi overlap.
hierarchy.motif_level: DEFERRED, unchanged from Step 1.5/1.6 -- not implemented in this step.

one_alpha_many_phi_behavior.rule: One Alpha with N qualifying edges produces N atomic phi records -- never hashed together as one primary identity.
one_alpha_many_phi_behavior.proof: tests/test_alpha_memory_phi_identity.py::test_one_alpha_with_n_qualifying_edges_produces_n_atomic_phi_tokens (3 edges -> 3 distinct phi_ids) and test_shared_edge_across_two_alphas_produces_two_distinct_phi_records (the same literal edge, linked to two Alphas, produces two separate records, never collapsed).
one_alpha_many_phi_behavior.real_data_confirmation: Real NVDA run 2f8ee897 (full historical scan against all persisted NVDA runs): A101 alone produced 5 atomic phi tokens from its 5 linked edges; A103 produced 4. Neither collapsed into a single per-Alpha identity.

aggregate_fingerprint_behavior.classification: Explicitly reported under 'aggregate_fingerprints' in the run_audit.json alpha_memory section, using aggregate_fingerprint_id (never phi_id) and AGGREGATE_FINGERPRINT_VERSION (never PHI_EDGE_IDENTITY_VERSION) -- no artifact/consumer can mistake it for the primary identity.
aggregate_fingerprint_behavior.arithmetic_unchanged: tests/test_alpha_memory_phi_identity.py::test_aggregate_fingerprint_arithmetic_is_unchanged_from_step1 proves the hash formula is byte-identical to Step 1's original computation.
aggregate_fingerprint_behavior.real_data_confirmation: Real NVDA pair (2f8ee897 vs c9abf687): 0 of 6/5 aggregate fingerprints matched (same 0% finding as Step 1/1.5), while 2 atomic phi edges DID match -- direct proof that whole-Alpha aggregate matching materially understates real recurrence relative to atomic matching.

real_offline_verification.method: Same persisted NVDA x2 and MSFT x2 runs used throughout the audits. No new research, zero Provider/TradingAgents calls.

NVDA.qualitative_result: ATOMIC MATCHING (2) > WHOLE-ALPHA AGGREGATE MATCHING (0) -- confirmed on real data, exactly the expected direction. Actual values reported, not manufactured.

MSFT.qualitative_result: BOTH ZERO for this specific pair -- reported honestly, not smoothed over. Root cause (documented in Step 1.6): MSFT run_a (07ddc074) has only 1 edge with any alpha_ids attached at all, an independent data-quality/coverage limitation of that specific run predating this step, not a defect introduced by the atomic model. This pair does not demonstrate the expected qualitative improvement; the NVDA pair does.

bonus_real_data_check_full_nvda_history.description: build_run_audit_payload() run against 2f8ee897 with the reader scanning ALL persisted NVDA runs (not just the one designated pair) -- the actual production behavior.
bonus_real_data_check_full_nvda_history.result: 15 current atomic phi tokens; alpha_memory_summary shows A001 1/2 matched, A101 1/5, A102 1/2, A103 2/4, A301 1/1, A501 0/1 historically matched against prior NVDA runs; 12 alpha_attribution_variance signals and 7 edge_type_variance signals detected across the full historical corpus -- substantially richer real recognition than the isolated 2-run comparison above, consistent with expectations for a reader that scans the complete persisted history rather than just one designated pair.

alpha_attribution_variance.definition: For the same (ticker, source, edge_type, target), reports every distinct alpha_ids set observed across a ticker's persisted runs and which run_id(s) produced each variant.
alpha_attribution_variance.audit_only_guarantees: No merging, no equivalence inference, no scoring, no penalty, no reinforcement -- verified by tests/test_alpha_memory_history_reader.py::test_alpha_attribution_variance_is_detected_and_does_not_merge_phi_ids (both variants remain listed with their own phi_ids; no field labels one variant 'correct').
alpha_attribution_variance.real_data_result: 12 signals detected scanning the complete real, persisted NVDA run history.

edge_type_variance.definition: For the same (ticker, source, target), reports every distinct edge_type observed across a ticker's persisted runs and which run_id(s) produced each variant.
edge_type_variance.audit_only_guarantees: Same guarantees as above -- verified by test_edge_type_variance_is_detected_and_does_not_merge_phi_ids.
edge_type_variance.real_data_result: 7 signals detected scanning the complete real, persisted NVDA run history.
